entry.title: Mini-JV 2.0.0
entry.summary: # JV-880 2.0.0 A rebuilt plugin with a new screen: JV-880 is now built on Akai's MPC Plugin SDK, with a rack-style panel and backlit LCD screens. ## What's new - **New screen**: - A matte black panel with blue and orange print and red-LED keys. - Every value on a backlit LCD, with a big number and a bar graph. entry.title: Mini-JV 1.0.9
entry.summary: - **ROM check in the installer app.** The plugin now declares its ROM files, so the installer app's **Your ROMs and files** step checks each file before copying it into `jv880-roms/roms/` (or `roms/expansions/` for SR-JV80 cards). entry.title: Mini-JV 1.0.8
entry.summary: - **Q-Links on track edit → automation now work.** The wrapper no longer asks MPC to rebuild its parameter screen after every parameter write (sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). Verified on a Force. - **PLAY page:** the macro knob values are no longer half hidden by the row below. Downloads: `JV-880-1.0.8-mpc-armv7.zip` for Gen1 MPC and Force, `JV-880-1.0.8-mpc-aarch64.zip` for Gen2 (MPC OS 3.x). Your ROMs in `jv880-roms/roms/` are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Mini-JV 1.0.6
entry.summary: Roland JV-880 emulation with a native MPC skin: BANKS browser, one-page PLAY, tone editors. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing plugins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk

entry.title: Mini-JV 1.0.4
entry.summary: Fixes loading on MPC OS 2.x (glibc 2.32): the 1.0.3 build bound pthread and dladdr calls to GLIBC_2.34, which MPC OS 2.x lacks. This build needs only GLIBC_2.17. The installer also works on Hakai-enabled systems (service `inmusic-mpc` instead of `acvs`). No other plugin changes; your ROMs are kept.
